items.title: How to Build a Free Version of any Paid App
items.summary:
Join The AI Advantage Club
https://joinaiaclub.com/igor

I used AI to recreate an app I used to pay for, then customized it to work exactly how I wanted. Here’s how to use Reverse Engineer Anything with ChatGPT, including my screen-drawing app, AIA Ink, and a second example inspired by Slido.

I’ll explain reverse engineering in plain English, show the request and setup, and share why this changes what we can build with AI.

Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) — GitHub
https://github.com/morluto/rea

ScreenBrush — Original Screen-Drawing App
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/screenbrush/id1233965871?mt=12

Slido — Original Q&A and Polling Tool
https://www.slido.com/

ArtCraft — Open-Source Creative Apps
https://getartcraft.com/
